atlas_basic.title: T1222 File and Directory Permissions Modification

strategies.name: Multi-Platform File and Directory Permissions Modification Detection Strategy

analytics.name: Analytic 0834
analytics.guidance: Sequential behavioral chain of privilege escalation through permission modification: (1) Process creation of permission-modifying utilities (icacls, takeown, attrib, cacls), (2) Correlation with unusual user context or timing, (3) DACL modification events targeting sensitive files/directories, (4) Subsequent file access or modification attempts indicating successful privilege bypass

tuning.description: Temporal correlation window for linking permission modification with subsequent access attempts (default: 300 seconds)
Environment-specific critical file and directory paths requiring permission change monitoring
Administrative accounts authorized to perform legitimate permission modifications
Time-based threshold for elevated alerting on permission changes outside business hours

analytics.name: Analytic 0835
analytics.guidance: Behavioral sequence of unauthorized privilege escalation via permission modification: (1) chmod/chown/setfacl process execution with suspicious parameters, (2) Targeting of critical system files or unusual permission values, (3) Correlation with non-privileged user context or unusual timing patterns, (4) Follow-on file access indicating successful permission bypass

tuning.description: Octal permission values that indicate potential malicious intent (default: 777, 755, 4755)
Linux filesystem paths requiring enhanced monitoring (/etc/, /usr/bin/, /home/)
User accounts permitted to perform system-level permission modifications
Statistical threshold for detecting unusual permission modification frequency

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: syscall in (chmod, fchmod, fchmodat, chown, fchown, fchownat, setxattr, lsetxattr, fsetxattr)

log_sources.name: auditd:PROCTITLE
log_sources.channel: proctitle contains chmod, chown, setfacl, or attr commands with suspicious parameters

analytics.name: Analytic 0836
analytics.guidance: macOS-specific permission modification behavioral chain: (1) chmod/chown/chflags process execution, (2) System Integrity Protection (SIP) bypass attempts, (3) Extended attribute (xattr) modifications, (4) Unified log correlation with file system events, (5) Subsequent access to previously restricted resources

tuning.description: macOS system paths protected by SIP that should never have permission modifications
chflags parameter combinations indicating evasive behavior (uchg, schg, hidden)
Extended attributes to monitor for unauthorized modifications
Log retention period for correlating permission changes with subsequent access

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: process execution events for chmod, chown, chflags with unusual parameters or targets

log_sources.name: fs:fsevents
log_sources.channel: file system events indicating permission or attribute changes

analytics.name: Analytic 0837
analytics.guidance: ESXi hypervisor permission modification behavioral chain: (1) SSH access to ESXi host, (2) chmod/chown execution on VMFS datastore files or system configuration, (3) Modification of VM configuration files (.vmx) or virtual disk permissions, (4) Hostd service log correlation, (5) vCenter permission change events if centrally managed

tuning.description: ESXi user accounts authorized for shell access and file system operations
VMFS datastore paths requiring permission change monitoring
Time correlation window for linking SSH access with permission modifications
Scope of vCenter audit event correlation with ESXi host activities

log_sources.name: esxi:shell
log_sources.channel: shell command execution for chmod, chown, or file permission modification on VMFS or system files

log_sources.name: esxi:hostd
log_sources.channel: host daemon events related to file or VM permission changes

log_sources.name: esxi:vpxd
log_sources.channel: permission change operations on datastores or VMs
